goal: Add a fail-closed lightweight required-status path for prose-only pull requests without dispatching or acquiring any database orchestrator lane or stage.
prohibited_actions: Do not modify a migration or any database state.
Do not authorize an unreadable, mixed, executable, workflow, script, test, configuration, migration, or behavior-changing rulebook diff.
Do not execute pull-request head code in the privileged status workflow.
Do not claim an author or reviewer lane, acquire preview, merge, or production, or emit a structural lifecycle event.
assumptions: Issue 2715 is repo-maintenance outside the shared-db structure orchestrator.
Plans and bounded declarative routing pointers are lightweight prose; behavior-changing instruction edits retain the full guarded path.
The narrow authorization command may serialize on the existing global coordination mutex only while proving production absent.
Independent exact-head review, required CI, guarded merge, and live acceptance remain repository delivery gates after worker completion.
stop_conditions: Stop if implementation requires a database or production write.
Stop if the pull-request head must be checked out or executed by pull_request_target.
Stop if an unknown diff can receive success.
